defaultConfig.ci.cvd.sportsStatsCategoryPrompt:
Extract all full player names mentioned in the following cricket query.
For any player mentioned by a partial or short name (e.g., 'Sachin', 'Viru', 'Kohli'), you must **resolve it to their commonly known full name** (e.g., 'Sachin Tendulkar', 'Virat Kohli').
If no player is mentioned, return 'None'.

Categorize the query by applying every relevant category from the list. A single query may belong to multiple categories.
Categories list:
1. player: queries asking for specific player or fetching for a specific player  or captain
2. series: queries related to series or trophy(like IPL, BBL, PSL) stats, series winners etc.
3. live_or_current_match: Queries focused on the current, live status or final outcome of an ongoing/unspecified match or series. This covers dynamic, moment-to-moment match data (e.g., scores, run rate, toss winner, active players, captain, playing XI) and essential final match/series status (e.g., Man of the Match, Man of the Series result). It must NOT contain historical filters like specific series, tournament, season, or ground.
4. player_in_match_performance: Queries asking for the performance statistics of a specific named player within the current, live, or most recent match (e.g., runs scored, wickets taken, catches, or strike rate of a named player today). This category is used when the query names a player but lacks any historical (series/season) filter.
5. aggregates_in_live_match: Queries asking for a statistical aggregate (e.g., 'highest run getter', 'top wicket taker', 'most sixes') when NO explicit historical filter (specific series, season, player name, match format, or team) is provided. This category applies when the query implicitly refers to the current, live, or most recent match/series aggregate.
6. batting: Queries related to fundamental batting statistics (e.g., score, strike rate) and identification of current batsmen and non striker (e.g., 'who is batting', 'score of virat'). This category also includes general queries for batting-related aggregate records (e.g., 'highest run getter') regardless of context.
7. bowling_fielding: queries related to bowling stats, economy rate, types of bowlers etc. Also for identification of current bowler (e.g., 'who is bowling', 'who is currently bowling'). Also queries related to fielding stats, catches, run outs, stumpings etc. This category also includes general queries for bowling and fielding related aggregate records (e.g., 'highest wicket taker') regardless of context.
8. all_round: queries related to all-rounders
9. partnerships: Queries related specifically to the partnership between two batsmen. This includes total runs added, time spent, specific partnership records (e.g., highest partnership ever), or current partnership statistics.
10. team: Queries related to a specific team or country, including team statistics, rankings, head-to-head records, or results for a specific team fixture (e.g., 'Ind vs Aus' score). This category handles any query where a team name acts as a specific filter.
11. ball_by_ball: queries related to ball by ball, non-striker, match phases(powerplay, middle and death overs etc), limited overs, etc. Queries regarding strike rate, economy, etc
12. over_by_over: Queries related to match statistics, scores, or performance broken down by individual overs or sets of overs.
13. award: queries related to achievement like man of the match, etc.
14. debut: queries related to player debut information
15. runout: queries related to runouts
16. squads: queries related to team squads, playing 11 etc.
17. bowler_playing_style: queries related to bowler playing styles (e.g., fast bowler, spinner etc.)
18. batting_playing_style: queries related to batting playing styles (e.g., left hand batsman etc.)
19. superover: queries related to super overs, tied matches, and their outcomes
24. win_loss_probabilty: queries related to win/loss probabilities, match predictions, or outcome forecasts
25. result_status: queries related to match result and status. Queries on how match is won or lost
26. ball_type: queries related to types of balls bowled (e.g., yorker, bouncer etc.)
27. format: queries related to match format like tests, ODIs, T20s
